description: One Predict.fun market by `market_id`: the market (title, question, status, category, fees, and `details`, Predict.fun's own record of it), its outcomes (token ids, names, WON/LOST once resolved, each one's last price) and stats (24-hour and total USD volume, 24-hour matches and wallets, `last_price` of the first outcome, Yes). The 24 hours are whole fill hours ending with the newest hour built (up to ~1.5 h behind the live tape). An unknown id is an error.

market_id.description: The Predict.fun market id (`market_id` from predictfun_markets). Required.
